part1.setup: scratch/'ro' created 0o555; output = ro/'out'; inputs are the pinned HERE sources
part1.mechanism: OUTDIR opens the read-only parent fd and stats 'out' ENOENT; READ and plan succeed; the first os.mkdir(basename, dir_fd=ro) fails EACCES on the 0o555 parent, mapped to C2B-WRITE with no entry created
part1.restore: os.chmod(ro, 0o700) in finally so the scratch subtree stays removable

part2.setup: copy_inputs(scratch) writes b9-applied.json, proof-export.json, setup-record.json copies; output = scratch/'out'
part2.wrapper: consumer_wrapper(after) delegates r2.prepare_c2_issue then after(result) rewrites the on-disk setup-record.json copy to RAW[SET] + b' ' via O_WRONLY|O_TRUNC|O_NOFOLLOW
part2.mechanism: stage 3 READ captures the original copy bytes; CONSUMER (stage 4) runs the wrapper, changing the on-disk copy; WRITE (stage 5) creates the full output; REREAD (stage 6) re-reads the copies, finds a byte difference and refuses C2B-REREAD, then cleanup removes exactly the entries this call created
part2.assertions: assert_cli_refusal C2B-REREAD; tree(scratch) == sorted(['ro/', 'b9-applied.json', 'proof-export.json', 'setup-record.json']): the output and contexts are gone, the three input copies and the emptied ro dir remain

run.derives: run_counts[name] = consumer-in-run + builder host calls (inputs identical, so the consumer component equals the baseline)

testR17.oracles: CONSUMER_HOST_APIS, BUILDER_HOST_APIS, counted(), fresh_export/fresh_setup, K6_EXPIRY, POLICY, run_main, assert_cli_success, assert_inputs_unchanged, tree from the prefix; the 7 consumer APIs from API dependency.consumerHostApis and the consumer BUILD/STATEMENT/DIGEST call sites; the builder's 4 from CB409/CB410 equality checks and API dependency.builderHostApis

effects.filesystem: each method uses exactly one case_scratch() directory; writes stay under it (and under its ro subdir / input copies); reads of the pinned HERE inputs are read only
effects.transientGlobalState: R14 reads the process umask with a set/restore pair (net unchanged); R16 chmods its own scratch subdir 0o555 then 0o700
effects.touchedModules: wraps r2.prepare_c2_issue (R16 consumer_wrapper) and host_codec host APIs (R17 counted); restores in finally; never patches os, builtins, json or R4

sourceOnlyGaps: R14 cannot prove durability/fsync (none is claimed) and does not scan the whole filesystem; it checks the pinned inputs and the exact scratch output tree only.
R16 cannot observe internal cleanup order; it observes the post-refusal tree (no output) as the contract's incompleteness marker.

R17 cannot inspect the builder's internally parsed dicts for mutation; it checks the consumer's deep-copied records and the on-disk inputs, and asserts host-call presence by baseline difference rather than exact totals. Whole-filesystem non-touch beyond the pinned inputs and the scratch tree is a source-audit obligation that allowed instrumentation cannot fully observe.
Environmental exceptions not mapped by the contract (for example EMFILE during the counted runs) propagate per the API and are not manufactured by any forbidden patch.
prefixCompatibility: no incompatibility found; the base-class helpers (r4, run_main, assert_cli_success, assert_cli_refusal, case_scratch, copy_inputs, assert_inputs_unchanged, consumer_wrapper, counted) and the module helpers (tree, require_unprivileged, fresh_export, fresh_setup) and literals (ROSTER, CASES, K6_EXPIRY/_TEXT, POLICY, CONSUMER_HOST_APIS, BUILDER_HOST_APIS, RAW, SET, HERE, B9, EXP) cover every R14-R17 need as composed. Any later finding would be stated here, not worked around.
